claims.claim: BM25 is the weakest localiser on both corpora

claims.claim: MPNet-base (110M) below both 33M bi-encoders on both corpora, never significantly different

claims.where: Parameter count does not order the bi-encoders; Claim
claims.claim: Differences among the four bi-encoders are not significant after correction, on either corpus
On QASPER bge-reranker-base is the worst neural model
On QASPER bge-reranker-base is indistinguishable from BM25
On NQ bge-reranker-base is the best model
On NQ bge-reranker-base is significantly above BM25, MiniLM and MPNet after correction
On NQ the reranker's lead over BGE-small is not significant
On QASPER the 22M ms-marco cross-encoder matches the best bi-encoder
On NQ the reranker stage is worth +4 to +12 points at rank 1 over the bi-encoders
claims.detail: reranker minus bi-encoders on NQ: +4.3 to +12.0 points

claims.claim: Every NQ lift over chance is higher than the QASPER lift
Holm-significant pairs: 2 on QASPER (both BM25 vs neural), 6 on NQ
Every Holm-significant pair keeps an interval excluding zero under the document-cluster bootstrap
Gold spans per question: 2.09 on QASPER, 1.00 on NQ
